_readme: Priority-city extras. Quote and youtube only when sourced.
Quotes are city-tied lines from Parts Unknown field notes / off-the-cuff
(Explore Parts Unknown / CNN), show transcripts, The Layover, Wikiquote,
or a 2013 CNN interview. Never invent. Never reassign a line to fill a gap.
YouTube ids are official CNN or Max clips, verified via oEmbed.
An absent field stays empty. The city page already omits the quote and
shows 'No public clip linked' when there is no id.
